setup_steps: 2. Export PGP keys: gpg --export --armor > public.asc && gpg --export-secret-keys --armor > private.asc
4. Create real commits in both Alice and Bob repositories
5. Sign commits with your keys: git commit -S (PGP) or git commit (SSH)
6. Fill in commit hashes, key paths, and other config values
7. Start local hardhat node: npx hardhat node
8. Run integration test: bun test integration-test

required_commits.alice: Commit containing test cases that Bob's solution should pass
required_commits.bob: Commit containing solution code signed with your registered key

_instructions.security_note: This config contains sensitive key information - DO NOT commit to public repos
